title: SWE-1: THE FIRST FAMILY
lede: May 15, 2025 — weeks before the acquisition was signed — Windsurf shipped its own model family in the Wave 9 release: three tiers trained not to autocomplete code, but to survive the whole software-engineering process. It became the foundation of Cognition's in-house model line.
body:
## THE THESIS: FLOW AWARENESS The SWE-1 launch post argued that coding models were trained on the wrong task. Real engineering isn’t ‘produce the right snippet’ — it’s a shared timeline of half-finished states: the file you opened, the command that failed, the diff you’re about to revert. SWE-1 was trained with flow awareness — a model of the developer’s whole working session, not just the text cursor. ## THE THREE TIERS
tierrolefine print
SWE-1the flagship tool-caller inside Cascade~Claude 3.5 Sonnet-level tool-call reasoning, cheaper to serve; free promo for paid users
SWE-1-litethe unlimited tierreplaced Cascade Base at better quality; unlimited for every user, free or paid
SWE-1-minithe reflexessmall enough to run inside Tab’s latency budget; further trained for predictive actions rather than tool calls
## WHY IT MATTERED * It proved Windsurf could post-train its own frontier-adjacent model instead of renting one — the capability Cognition was really acquiring two months later. * The tiering pattern — flagship / unlimited / reflex — became the permanent architecture of the SWE line. * It established the SWE name and the family tradition: every subsequent release is optimized for the harness it lives in, not a chat arena. > We are launching our first family of models, dubbed SWE-1, optimized for the entire software engineering process, not just the task of coding. — Cognition, May 15, 2025 ## THE GENEALOGY 
SWE-1 family (may 2025)
├── SWE-1 ....... flagship tool-call model, Cascade
├── SWE-1-lite .. unlimited tier, replaces Cascade Base
└── SWE-1-mini .. Tab predictive engine, latency-class
Next hall: the family gets a speed obsession — SWE-1.5.
